description: This file defines the ParserInputMethodClients class, a specialized parser for input method client trace data in a trace analysis tool. It extends AbstractParser and handles decoding, timestamp extraction, and processing of trace entries related to input method clients.

classes.name: ParserInputMethodClients
classes.description: A parser class for input method client trace data, capable of decoding trace buffers, extracting timestamps, and processing trace entries.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type identifier for input method clients.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number signature for identifying input method client trace files.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into trace entries, updating the time offset if present.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts a timestamp from a trace entry based on the specified timestamp type.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded trace entry, adding timestamp and transforming client info.
